To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

i) Sentic Computing can be successfully applied to the semantic analysis of social media; ii) the semantic representation of this knowledge can be useful for marketing purposes; iii) this knowledge can be used as a basis for the creation of a marketing strategy.

(i) the use of a multi-disciplinary framework, such as Sentic Computing, allows to overcome the limitations of the current state-of-the-art techniques for sentiment analysis; (ii) the use of Semantic Web techniques allows to encode and represent this information in a machine-processable and interoperable way; (iii) the use of multi-faceted classifications allows users to easily browse and navigate this knowledge base.

i) the Sentic Computing approach to opinion mining is a valid and effective solution for extracting useful information from social data; ii) this information can be encoded in a semantic aware way, and; iii) this information can help marketers to understand how customers perceive their product, brand, or organization.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (i) how to extract useful information from unstructured data; (ii) how to semantically represent and classify this information and (iii) how to make this knowledge available to the public.
the development of an innovative system for opinion mining, sentiment analysis and semantic representation of social media content.

1) the development of a multi-lingual, multi-disciplinary, multi-aspect, multi-faceted and multi-ontology semantic web application to support the analysis of opinions in social media, 2) the extraction of knowledge and its representation in a structured format, 3) the development of an innovative and intuitive interface to browse and visualize the knowledge extracted.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this work represents a step forward towards the development of an automatic system able to extract useful information from social web, encode it and represent it in a semantic format, thus allowing a more effective and complete use of this information by marketers.
the Sentic Computing approach to opinion mining, sentiment analysis and product positioning in social media is an innovative and effective way to deal with this kind of information.
Sentic Computing is a promising approach to extract and represent useful information from social networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to build a semantic knowledge base for marketing purposes.
we are trying to create a knowledge base of product opinions, in a way similar to the Wikipedia for knowledge, but for opinions.

we have created a system which is capable to analyze the opinions about commercial products expressed in social media, to semantically encode and represent the results and to provide a multi-facetted view of this information to marketers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, by using Sentic Computing, we are able to extract, semantically and affectivelly encode and represent useful information from social data in order to help marketers to understand the opinions and feelings of customers about their products.
the semantic representation of social media data can be used to create an effective marketing strategy.
Sentic Computing is a promising technique for opinion mining in social media, and that semantic web techniques are useful to encode and represent the results.
